entities.$comment: @generated by schema-gen from the schema definitions. Do not edit.

BIMCraft_MaterialConcrete.description:
Strength and strain properties of a concrete grade, each with its source. An IFC export writes the values to `Pset_MaterialConcrete`, with each source in the property's Specification.

Applies to `Material`.

CharacteristicCompressiveStrength.description:
Characteristic cylinder compressive strength at 28 days.

In Pa.

MeanCompressiveStrength.description:
Mean cylinder compressive strength at 28 days.

In Pa.

MeanTensileStrength.description:
Mean axial tensile strength.

In Pa.

ParabolaExponent.description: Exponent of the parabola of the parabola-rectangle diagram.

StrainAtPeakStress.description: Compressive strain at which the parabola reaches the peak stress, as a ratio.

UltimateCompressiveStrain.description: Ultimate compressive strain, as a ratio.

BIMCraft_MaterialMechanical.description:
Mechanical and physical properties of a material, each with its source. An IFC export writes the values to `Pset_MaterialCommon` and `Pset_MaterialMechanical`, with each source in the property's Specification.

Applies to `Material`.

MassDensity.description:
Mass per unit volume.

In kg/m³.

PoissonRatio.description: Ratio of lateral to axial strain under axial load.

YoungModulus.description:
Modulus of elasticity; for concrete, the secant modulus.

In Pa.

BIMCraft_MaterialSteel.description:
Strength and ductility properties of a steel grade, each with its source. An IFC export writes the values to `Pset_MaterialSteel`, with each source in the property's Specification.

Applies to `Material`.

HardeningRatio.description: Ratio of tensile strength to yield strength.

UltimateStrain.description: Strain at maximum load, as a ratio.

UltimateStrength.description:
Characteristic or nominal ultimate tensile strength.

In Pa.

YieldStrength.description:
Characteristic or nominal yield strength.

In Pa.

BehaviourLaw.description: How the stress in a material follows its strain.

Material.description: A substance that elements are made of, such as a concrete or steel grade (MAT-01). Its behaviour law says how it responds to strain; its properties, in the property sets below, each cite the design-code clause they come from (REP-05).

design_code.description: The design code the properties follow, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004`.

name.description: The material's name, such as `C30/37` or `S355`.

MaterialCategory.description: What a material is; it decides which behaviour laws suit it.

ObjectId.description: The stable 128-bit identifier of an object, as an IFC GlobalId.

Site.description: The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

base_point_eastings.description:
Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame.

In m.

base_point_height.description:
Orthogonal height of the project base point.

In m.

base_point_northings.description:
Northing of the project base point.

In m.

crs_epsg.description: EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced.

grid_rotation.description:
Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise.

In rad.

scale.description: Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero.

survey_point_eastings.description:
Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point.

In m.

survey_point_height.description:
Orthogonal height of the survey point.

In m.

survey_point_northings.description:
Northing of the survey point.

In m.

Source.description: The document and clause a value comes from.
